summary.text: Clyde Shabazz, a Green Party candidate, lost the November 3, 2026 election for U.S. House in Michigan's 6th District to Debbie Dingell.
Nominated at the party's April 25, 2026 convention, he had run for Congress as a Green Party candidate in 2020 and 2024.
He received 0.5% of the vote to Debbie Dingell's 67.4%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
